source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: WRI is weighted sequential isolation and Theorem 4.1 is an MSE upper bound; the paper then minimizes a simulated surrogate M(w), rather than an exact dense RDIM risk matrix.
Counting linear extensions is fixed-parameter intractable for cover-graph treewidth and FPT for incomparability-graph treewidth.
The cover-graph tree-decomposition algorithm counts linear extensions in O-tilde(t! n^(t+3)) bit operations and handles joins through multivariate-polynomial machinery.
Exact full-neighborhood exposure probability for randomized 3-net clustering is NP-hard on arbitrary graphs, while Monte Carlo exposure-probability estimators are provided.

Make B a positive rational or real-algebraic encoded input in the SDP theorem, and state the corresponding bit-complexity model for H and Q_l.

Elevate the oracle question with a theorem-level transfer: prove that an FPT marked-moment oracle yields a certified WRI mixture with a stated approximation/runtime guarantee that is unavailable under the unrestricted-minimax comparator.

Develop either a parameter-preserving reduction from a known treewidth-hard counting problem to a specified tagged coefficient, or a concrete separator normalization invariant; this is the route that turns the field-level OEQ into a decisive result.
